title: Change your name on a boat, vessel or other maritime licence record
summary: You can update your name on maritime records, such as a vessel registration or boat licence, by visiting a Service NSW Centre or submitting a request via mail.
intro: If you need to change your name on maritime-related products or services such as a vessel registration or your boat licence, you can update in person at a Service NSW Centre, or via mail.
who_can_apply: Need to change name on maritime-related products or services (e.g., vessel registration, boat licence).
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Change of Records – Maritime Products Only'
If you hold a vehicle registration, NSW driver licence or combined licence and/or photo card, you must use the 'Change of Records - Road and Maritime Products' form and visit a service centre.

faqs.q: How can I change my name on my boat or vessel records?
faqs.a: You can update your name on maritime records by visiting a Service NSW Centre or submitting a request via mail.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to change my name?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, proof of name change documentation, and the 'Change of Records – Maritime Products Only' form.
